source: Hero skill configs (base timings at Combo Speed rating 0).
note: In play, combo timing is the same for every Invoker (observed in game). These per-hero values are the raw skill config and are NOT real timing differences: preSec/castSec/endSec are animation lengths, and requiredSec (0.4-0.9 s in config) does not translate into faster or slower combos either. Do not rank or compare heroes by these numbers; keep them for reference only.
unconfirmed: How Combo Speed rating scales these timings is in stat_curves.json only if the game exposes it; StatCurves has no Combo Speed column, so the scaling is not exported yet.
animationSec sums pre+cast+end over Combo1-5; requiredSec sums ComboAnimationRequiredTime (the time before the next hit can start).
